title: Take Action
body:
## Attend a meeting

The Task Force holds public meetings on the third Wednesday of each month at 7:00 p.m. at St. Louis City Hall, Michigan. Remote attendance is available via Zoom — login details are posted in the News section a few days before each meeting, along with the agenda, so you can review the topics before deciding whether to attend.

## Support the work financially

Donations support river cleanup and human health research efforts. To contribute, contact the Treasurer at gjsgilmore@yahoo.com with your name, address, and contact information (needed for tax-exempt donation records). You can also donate directly through this site's [Donate](/donate) page.
